description: Get business information including name, type, service area, contact details, working hours, supported languages, enabled features, and a profile image (logo or personal photo) when the owner has uploaded one. Use 'attributeDetails' (natural-language sentences about the business's offerings, approach, and specialties) to reason about fit for the user. The 'cardChips' and 'cardChipGroups' fields are UI-only display data — ignore them. The response echoes the exact slug; reuse it verbatim in later tool calls. Always available for any business.

slug.description: The exact URL slug returned by search_businesses (e.g. 'nikos-plumbing-a3f2'). Copy it verbatim.

name: get_business_info
